text: They built a fire so large, the birds that flew over it fell from the sky.
And into it, they threw one man... for the crime of saying: my Lord is Allah.
But Allah said: "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim."
Who was this man, who stood alone against his father, his people, and a king?
The man Allah Himself took as a friend. The father of the prophets. The one who built the Kaaba.
This is the complete story of Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, from the Quran.
